svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.aria-label: A floating waybar of frosted pills: workspaces, the window title, Tannoy's song, then the lamps, where Tablet's network lamp is dim. In a terminal an agent runs tablet need work for a Gradle build, and the lamp turns amber with the word asked. A right-click opens the Tablet drawer out of it: the agent's request with its command, directory and unverified reason, and Connect work. A click on Connect turns the lamp into a pulsing ellipsis, then sign in while a browser finishes the web sign-in, then frost: the drawer holds work with its traffic graph and both probes answering, and the build runs in the terminal. The server goes quiet: the probes fail twice, the lamp says stale in orange and the drawer explains that openvpn3 says connected but nothing answers. A click on Reconnect brings it back. The Checks tab shows both probes, the resolvers and routing-only zones on tun0 and openvpn3's counters; the History tab shows connected, stale, reconnected and an older dropped session. A click outside closes the drawer.

g.text: ● I'll build it; Nexus is on the corporate VPN.
$ tablet need work --reason "Nexus only answers on the VPN" \
tablet: work is not connected; asking on the bar
tablet: work is connected; running ./gradlew assemble
